title: SAFEMA Tribunal Refuses to Confiscate Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Shares Despite FEMA Violations
description: SAFEMA Tribunal held confiscation under Section 13(2) of FEMA is discretionary and upheld the decision not to confiscate TMB shares.The post SAFEMA Tribunal Refuses to Confiscate Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Shares Despite FEMA Violations appeared first on TaxGuru.
